name: Munich Residence
description: Palace, buildings & gardens housing state-owned museums, with original interiors & artworks.

name: English Garden
description: Expansive, 18th-century, urban park with 78km of cycling/jogging trails & a lakeside beer garden.

name: Marienplatz
description: City-center square & transport hub with towering St. Peter's church, 2 town halls & a toy museum.

name: Frauenkirche
description: 2 towers top this restored Gothic church, bombed in 1945, known for its legendary Devil's footprint.

name: Hofbräuhaus München
description: 3-floor beer hall dating back to the 16th century, with a Bavarian restaurant, shows & upbeat vibe.

name: Fischbrunnen
description: Fish Fountain, a city landmark with a history dating to the Middle Ages, is a popular photo op.

name: Odeonsplatz
description: Large early 19th-century square lined by ornate buildings, some of them with a Roman influence.

name: Hofgarten
description: City park with formal lawns & flower beds, court gardens of the royal residence in the 17th century.

name: Rathaus-Glockenspiel
description: Town Hall clocktower with figurines that re-enact events from Munich's history daily.

name: Karlsplatz (Stachus)
description: Bustling square featuring historical buildings, a fountain & an underground shopping arcade.

name: Nymphenburg Palace
description: A 200-hectare palace estate with rococo interiors, coach display & symmetrical baroque gardens.

name: Lion's Tower
description: Once a cattle marketplace, this square features a fountain with cow sculptures & a Christmas market.

name: Mariensäule
description: Towering column in Marienplatz, erected in 1638 & topped by a statue of the Virgin Mary.

name: Bavarian National Museum
description: Major cultural history museum with a vast collection, from 5th-century church art to antique clocks.

name: Toy Museum Munich
description: A toy museum now occupies 4 levels of this Gothic town hall & clock tower from the 14th century.

name: Eisbachwelle
description: There's year-round surfing on this continuous wave on the Englischer Garten's Eisbach River.

name: Siegestor
description: Famous 19th-century triumphal arch featuring a bronze sculpture of Bavaria with 4 lions.

name: Angel of Peace
description: Park featuring a peace monument depicted by a golden angel, plus mosaics & a viewing deck.

name: Königsplatz
description: Landmark square known for its monumental, neo-classical buildings, including an antiquity museum.

name: Monument to King Ludwig I
description: Grand bronze statue of King Ludwig I on horseback created in 1862 by the sculptor Max von Widnmann.

name: Sendlinger Tor
description: Restored, 14th-century red-brick gate with 2 towers, opening onto an Old Town plaza with a fountain.

name: Augustiner Klosterwirt
description: Traditional food & Augustiner kegs in old-school Bavarian environs with seating on 2 floors.

name: Zum Alten Markt
description: Refined Bavarian food & Spaten beer served in a cozy 18th-century dining room with attached garden.

name: Münchner Stubn
description: Schnitzel, burgers, beer & Bavarian classics in a stylish pub with multiple wood-clad rooms.

name: Andy's Krablergarten
description: Relaxed restaurant & beer garden serving hearty Bavarian sides, grills & schnitzels.

name: Wirtshaus in der Au
description: Bavarian restaurant, tavern & beer garden established in 1901, known for its dumplings & jazz music.

name: Steinheil 16
description: Casual restaurant specializing in schnitzel plates & fried sides, plus beer, wine & cocktails.

name: Le Stollberg
description: Creative French-inspired cuisine focused on offal & seasonal dishes, with upscale decor & terrace.

name: Les Deux
description: Elegant setting for modern French food & an extensive wine list, plus a futuristic brasserie area.

name: Wirtshaus Zum Straubinger
description: Traditional Bavarian tavern & beer garden with cozily stylish wooden decor, serving regional dishes.

name: Little London / Bar & Grill
description: Refined, British-inspired steakhouse & bar offering cocktails & an extensive wine list.

name: Giorgia Trattoria
description: Relaxed Italian restaurant with colorful decor serving up classics like pizza & pasta.

name: Restaurant Pfistermühle
description: Classic dining room in the vaults of an old 16th-century mill, serving high-end Bavarian cuisine.

name: Sofitel Munich Bayerpost
description: Elegant rooms & glamorous suites in a plush hotel with a French restaurant & an indoor heated pool.

name: Hotel Bayerischer Hof
description: Upscale hotel offering a comedy club, a cinema & a nightclub, plus dining, bars & a spa.

name: Platzl Hotel
description: Relaxed hotel with a Bavarian restaurant & a quaint tavern, plus a steam room & a sauna.

name: Hotel München Palace
description: Upscale hotel featuring refined rooms, plus a quaint restaurant, a gym & a rooftop terrace.

name: LOUIS Hotel
description: Modern hotel with an upscale restaurant, an elegant bar & a fitness center, plus free Wi-Fi.

name: The Charles Hotel
description: Contemporary lodging with free Wi-Fi, a spa & a pool, plus Italian dining & a cozy bar.

name: Holiday Inn Munich - City Centre, an IHG Hotel
description: Unassuming rooms & suites in a laid-back lodging with free Wi-Fi & a Bavarian restaurant.

name: Westpark
description: Public park with Asian gardens, rose beds, & an open-air floating stage for music, movies & theater.

name: Luitpoldpark
description: 33-hectare public park around a scenic hill made from WWII rubble with a hedge maze & restaurant.

name: Schlosspark Nymphenburg
description: Classical English-style palace park with neat flowerbeds, ornamental pool & secluded wooded area.

name: Allacher Lohe, Natur & Landschaftsschutzgebiet
description: Forested nature reserve on 150 hectares offering a lake, cycling trails & many native plant species.

name: Panzerwiese
description: This 280-hectare nature reserve features forest & grassland, plus diverse plants & small animals.

name: Maximiliansanlagen
description: Quiet, tree-lined park beside the river with walking & jogging trails, plus sled hills in winter.

name: Alter Botanischer Garten
description: Tree-filled park with a cafe & beer garden, lawns & the Fountain of Neptune, plus curling in winter.

name: South Park
description: Spacious park with tree-topped walking/jogging paths, fitness equipment, benches & table tennis.
